arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَصَيِّرْنَـا إلَى مَحْبُوبِكَ مِنَ التَّوْبَةِ وَأَزِلْنَا عَنْ مَكْرُوهِكَ مِنَ الإصْرَارِ.
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih waṣayyirnā ilā maḥbūbika mina al-tawbah wa-azilnaa ʿan makroohika mina al-iṣraar
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, make us go to the repentance that Thou lovest and make us leave the persistence that Thou hatest!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ وَمَتَى وَقَفْنَا بَيْنَ نَقْصَيْنِ فِي دِين أَوْ دُنْيَا فَأَوْقِعِ النَّقْصَ بِأَسْرَعِهِمَا فَنَاءً ، وَاجْعَلِ التّوْبَةَ فِي أَطْوَلِهِمَا بَقَاءً.
transliteration: allāhumma wa matā waqafnā bayna naqṣayn fī dīn aw dunyā fa-aawqiʿin-naqṣa bi-asraʿihi-mā fanāʾan wa-ajʿal-i at-tawba fī aṭwalihimā baqā'an
english_text: O God, when we halt before two decreases, in religion or in this world, let the decrease fall upon that which passes quickly and relent in that which lasts the longer!

arabic_text: وَإذَا هَمَمْنَا بِهَمَّيْنِ يُرْضِيكَ أَحَدُهُمَا عَنَّا وَيُسْخِطُكَ الآخَرُ عَلَيْنَا ، فَمِلْ بِنَا إلَى مَا يُرْضِيْكَ عَنَّا ، وَأَوْهِنْ قُوَّتَنَا عَمَّا يُسْخِطُكَ عَلَيْنَا ،
transliteration: wa-itha hamamna bihimmayni yurdiyka ahaduhuma 'anna wa yuskhitu-ka al-akhiru 'alay-na famli binā ilā mā yurđīka ʿannā wa-aʾwhin quwwatanā ʿammā yuskhithuka ʿalaynā
english_text: When we set out after two concerns, one of which makes Thee pleased with us and the other of which displeases Thee, incline us toward that which makes Thee pleased and weaken our strength in that which displeases Thee!

arabic_text: وَلاَ تُخَلِّ فِي ذلِكَ بَيْنَ نُفُوسِنَا وَاخْتِيَارِهَا فَإنَّهَا مُخْتَارَةٌ لِلْبَاطِلِ إلاَّ مَا وَفَّقْتَ أَمَّارَةٌ بالسُّوءِ إلاّ مَا رَحِمْتَ
transliteration: walā tuḫallif fī ḏalika bayna nufūsinā wa-ikhtiyārihā fa'innahā mukhtāratun lil-bāṭili illā mā waffaqtu ammāratan bissū'i illā mā raḥimta
english_text: Leave not our souls alone to choose in that, for they choose falsehood except inasmuch as Thou givest success, and they command to evil except inasmuch as Thou hast mercy!

arabic_text: اللَّهمَّ وَإنَّكَ مِنَ الضَّعْفِ خَلَقْتَنَا، وَعَلَى الْوَهْنِ بَنَيْتَنَا ، وَمِنْ ماُءٌُِِ مَهِين ابْتَدَأتَنَا ،
transliteration: allāhumma wa innaka mina al-ḍaʿfi khalaqtanā waʿalā al-wahni banaytanā, wa min māʾin maheen ibtadātanā
english_text: O God, thou created us from frailty, built us up from feebleness, and began us from a mean water;

arabic_text: فَلاَ حَوْلَ لَنَا إلاّ بِقُوَّتِكَ وَلا قُوَّةَ لَنَا إلاّ بِعَونِِكَ ،
transliteration: fala ḥawla lana illa bi quwwatika wa la quwwata lana illa bi ʿawnika
english_text: we have no force except through Thy strength and no strength except through Thy help.

arabic_text: فَأيِّدْنَا بِتَوْفِيقِكَ وَسَدِّدْنَا بِتَسْدِيدِكَ وَأعْمِ أَبْصَارَ قُلُوبِنَا عَمَّا خَالَفَ مَحَبَّتَكَ وَلا تَجْعَلْ لِشَيْء مِنْ جَوَارِحِنَا نُفُوذاً فِي مَعْصِيَتِكَ.
transliteration: fa'ayyidna bi tawfiqika wa saddidna bi tasdiidika wa aʿmi ʾabṣāra qulūbinā ʿammā khālafa maḥabbataka walā tajʿal li-shayʾin min jawāriḥinā nufūḏan fī maʿṣiyatika
english_text: So confirm us by giving us success, point us the right way by Thy pointing, blind the eyes of our hearts toward everything opposed to Thy love, and set not in any of our limbs passage to disobeying Thee!

arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَد وَآلِهِ وَاجْعَلْ هَمَسَاتِ قُلُوبِنَا وَحَرَكَاتِ أَعْضَائِنَا ، وَلَمَحَاتِ أَعْيُنِنَا ، وَلَهَجَاتِ ألسِنَتِنَا فِيْ مُوجِبَاتِ ثَوَابِكَ، حَتَّى لاَ تَفُوتَنَا حَسَنَةٌ نَسْتَحِقُّ بِهَا جَزَآءَكَ ،
transliteration: allāhumma faṣalli ʿalā muḥammadin wa ālihī wa-ajʿal hamsāti qulūbinā wa-harakāti aʿḍāʾinā walamaḥāti aʿyūninā, walahaǧāti alsinatinā fī mūjibāti thawābika ḥattā lā tafūtanā ḥasanatun nastahiqqu bihā jazāʾaka
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household and assign the whisperings of our hearts, the movements of our members, the glances of our eyes, and the idioms of our tongues, to that which makes incumbent Thy reward, lest a good deed slip by us, through which we might deserve Thy repayment,

arabic_text: وَلا تَبْقَى لَنَا سَيِّئـةٌ نَسْتَوْجِبُ بِهَا عِقَابَكَ.
transliteration: wala tabqa lana sayyiatun nastawjibu biha 'iqabak
english_text: or an evil deed remain with us, by which we might merit Thy punishment!
